prompt: Create a standalone mountain travel illustration on an 800 × 480 landscape canvas for a compact website header. Show a neutral layered mountain range, green foothills, a winding footpath, and a tiny simple cable car. Do not depict a recognizable city, a named peak, or a season dominated by snow. Use crisp, delicate ink outlines in #0b1020 and soft, flat watercolor-like fills: pale blue #bce6fb, sage #b8d2bc, warm sand #f4d9a4, with restrained yellow and pink accents. Arrange the focal cluster toward the center-right and bottom, filling most of the canvas while retaining organic open edges at the left and top. Keep the exterior fully transparent. No UI, text, frame, or logos.
